name: api-specs-writer
description: Opt-in only — dispatch this agent only when the user has explicitly asked for API documentation; never proactively or by default after code changes. Use it to document implemented HTTP APIs. It reads the actual implementation (handlers, routes, request/response structs, middleware) and writes or updates the project's .claude/api/api-specs.md — path, method, headers, payload, response, examples, and a plain-language description per endpoint, then an API flow and sequence diagram. The API contract only, never the code structure behind it.
